all.label: All permissions (Super Admin)
all.help: Everything, including sensitive permissions. Only the Super Admin role has this.

users.label: Manage users
users.help: Invite people, deactivate them and give them roles they are allowed to give.

roles.label: Manage roles
roles.help: Create and change roles and their permissions. Sensitive: needs two-step sign-in.

terminology.label: Change the words used
terminology.help: Rename words such as $t(labels:client.singular) or $t(labels:offering.singular) for the institution.

organisation.label: Manage $t(labels:branch.plural) and teams
organisation.help: Create, move and archive $t(labels:branch.plural), departments and teams; set managers.

general.label: General settings
general.help: Default language and other general settings of the institution.

locale.label: Formats and money
locale.help: Time zone, currency, phone rules, payment methods.

office.label: Office calendar
office.help: Working days, working hours and quiet hours.

security.label: Security settings
security.help: Automatic sign-out and other security rules. Sensitive.

team.label: Team and report settings
team.help: Activity tracking, reports, scorecard, credits, notifications, who uses the website.

conversion.label: $t(labels:conversion.singular) settings
conversion.help: The $t(labels:conversion.singular) flow, approvals, the $t(labels:client.plural) tab, files and photos.

fees.label: Fee settings
fees.help: Fees, payment methods, receipt design and receipt numbers, reminders.

leads.label: $t(labels:lead.singular) settings
leads.help: Assignment, cards, filters, score, appointments, templates, reminders and escalations.

calls.label: Call settings
calls.help: Call-log sync, call lock, double-call warning, phone contacts.

ai.label: AI settings
ai.help: AI features, provider and monthly budget (keys stay in the vault).

institution_type.label: Institution type
institution_type.help: Choose the institution's types (school, college …), see a preview and apply them; reset areas to the type defaults.

manage.label: Manage integrations and keys
manage.help: Connect SMS, email and payment providers and store their keys. Sensitive.

view.label: View the audit log
view.help: See who changed what and when.

view.label: View sensitive fields
view.help: See fields marked sensitive, such as national ID numbers and amounts.

institutions.label: Manage institutions
institutions.help: Create, suspend and close institutions (Master Admin).

product_settings.label: Product settings
product_settings.help: Settings for the whole product, such as the minimum app version.

extensions.label: Manage extensions
extensions.help: Switch extensions on or off for institutions.

labels_lock.label: Lock words
labels_lock.help: Lock words that an institution may not change, such as a receipt title.

billing.label: Billing
billing.help: Plans, prices, invoices and payments of institutions.

support_access.label: Support access
support_access.help: Open an institution to help it, with its permission and fully logged.

view.label: See the panel
view.help: Dashboard and institution lists, read only.

profiles.label: Manage type profiles and packs
profiles.help: Industry packs, type profiles and their defaults.

users.label: Manage platform users
users.help: Invite platform users, change their role, deactivate them.
